body: Social intelligence enables agents to read social context, infer intent, and adapt over sustained dialogue. As language models become autonomous collaborators, it is central to building effective and trustworthy human-AI interaction. Existing reinforcement learning methods optimize single-turn utterances and sparse outcome rewards, producing short-sighted policies that struggle to manage goal-relationship tensions across multi-turn interactions. We propose SocialRL, a multi-turn reinforcement learning framework addressing both challenges. First, we apply multi-turn reinforcement learning using PPO that propagates delayed outcome rewards back to each turn, enabling long-horizon planning. Second, we design six process reward dimensions capturing the goal-relationship trade-off, including goal advancement, relational attunement, contextual coherence, etc. A reward model dynamically generates fine-grained scoring criteria for each dimension, while a stage-aware weight schedule prioritizes relationship-building in early turns, goal advancement mid-way, and balanced closure late. Across multiple social-dialogue benchmarks, SocialRL improves Goal Achievement by an average of 9.2 percentage points over the corresponding Base models. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of SocialRL across synthetic and real social scenes, as well as standard and challenging social scenarios.
summaryZh: SocialRL框架针对现有强化学习方法在多轮对话中缺乏长期规划的问题，引入了基于PPO的多轮强化学习机制，将延迟奖励传播至各对话轮次。该研究设计了包含目标推进、关系协调等六个维度的过程奖励模型，并采用阶段感知权重调度，使智能体在不同对话阶段平衡目标达成与社交关系维护。实验证明，该方法在多个社交对话基准测试中显著提升了智能体的目标达成率。

glossary.explanationZh: 近端策略优化，一种常用的强化学习算法，用于稳定策略更新。
多轮对话，指智能体在连续的交互过程中保持上下文连贯性。
过程奖励，指对交互过程中的中间行为进行评分，而非仅关注最终结果。
长视距，指模型在决策时考虑较长的时间跨度或多步交互影响。
